newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 662 retail money market mutual funds rose $166.2 million to $600.47 billion in the week ended November 13, the Investment Company Institute industry group said Thursday.
It said assets of the 405 taxable money market funds in the retail category rose $347.7 million to $489.83 billion, while assets of the 257 tax-exempt funds fell $181.5 million to $110.65 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 315 institutional money market funds rose $5.80 billion to $291.07 billion. Of these, the 250 taxable money market fund assets grew $6.02 billion to $261.50 billion, and assets of the 65 tax exempt funds fell $213.5 million to $29.57 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $891.54 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended November 6 were revised to $885.57 billion from $885.48 billion.
